_note: Reference size of each sample type, in mm, measured from webcam photos at 13.9 px/mm (about 5% scale uncertainty). width_mm (the narrow side) decides which filter catches it. Medians over the pieces found; 'rough' entries rest on few pieces or an indirect method. Re-measure with calipers when possible. Lengths don't affect sorting (grains can pass a hole end-first); width_mm does. Grain widths marked 'guess' are best estimates (photo widths run ~0.2-0.5 mm wide from edge blur; typical wild rice ~2 mm, long-grain rice ~1.8-2.2 mm); confirm with a sieve test on the real filters when possible.
